(C.I.D.) Office Notes
File No. L. 672
November 19, 1929.

A small shop at 1350B Avenue Road styled the
Avenue Book Store (愛文書局) has for sale a weekly
periodical entitled the "Awakened Lion" (醒獅), which
is published by the Chinese Youth Party (中國青年黨),
hitherto known as the Chinese Nationalistic Youth Group
(中國國家主義青年團). This party came into existence
in 1924 for the primary purpose of opposing the spread
of Communism in China, and its leader was a Szechuenese
named Tseng Chi (曾琦), a returned student from Japan.
Its activities have been confined to the distribution
on rare occasions of anti-Communistic literature and the
publication of the periodical "Awakened Lion". After
the arrival of the Nationalists who are opposed to this
Party, many of its members have gone to the North --
Tientsin, Peiping, and Moukden. The above store is
owned by one Kiang Tung-tsz (江同之), a native of
Anhui, and is being looked after by his assistant
named Wu Teh-hsi (吴德熙), a native of Szechuen.
The influence of this Party, the location of the Head-
quarters of which is unknown, is at present insignificant.
Although this party is looked upon with anything but
favour by the Kuomintang, its publication (the Awakened
Lion) still enjoys postal privileges.

Has Robertson
C. D. I.

The above report is of no
particular value to us, but
is the result of enquiries made
at the verbal request of the
French Police. The information
contained in the report has
been conveyed to them.
Jolepps.

（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
档案编号：L. 672
1929年11月19日。

爱文义路1350B号有一家名为“爱文书局”的小店，出售一种名为《醒狮》的周刊，该刊由中国青年党出版，该党此前称为中国国家主义青年团。该党成立于1924年，主要宗旨是反对共产主义在中国的蔓延，其领袖是一位名叫曾琦的四川人，系留日归国学生。该党的活动仅限于偶尔分发反共文献以及出版《醒狮》周刊。在反对该党的国民党人士到来后，其许多成员已前往北方——天津、北平和沈阳。上述书店由安徽籍人士江同之所有，并由其助手、四川籍人士吴德熙打理。该党总部所在地不明，目前影响力微乎其微。尽管国民党对该党颇不以为然，但其出版物《醒狮》仍享有邮政优惠待遇。

哈斯·罗伯逊
刑事侦缉处处长

上述报告对我们而言并无特别价值，但系应法国巡捕房的口头请求进行调查的结果。报告中包含的信息已转告法方。
乔勒普斯
